Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake:  
At step 12, WebSurfer clicked the Whole Foods result and landed on the UK site (wholefoodsmarket.co.uk) instead of the relevant Chicago/U.S. store page. That means the subsequent verification was based on the wrong website context, so it could not reliably confirm ready-to-eat salad availability or prices for the supermarket near Lincoln Park. This site mismatch is the first clear error that could lead to the wrong final answer.
